title: Clarify Your Vivid Vision
tagline: Get a clear, three-year picture of the business and life you actually want.
description: How to clarify, write, design, and roll out a Vivid Vision: a present-tense picture of your company and your life three years out, built so your whole team can see it and move toward it.
coreFocus: Help entrepreneurs clarify, communicate, and design their Vivid Vision.

title: Turn Your Vision Into a Plan
tagline: Master your calendar so the vision actually gets built.
description: Turning a vision into action: goal setting and focus, annual and quarterly and weekly rhythms, a personalized scoreboard, rituals, and the systems that keep the plan moving without you pushing it.
coreFocus: Turn vision into action through planning, rhythms, and systems.

title: Become the Vision-Driven Entrepreneur
tagline: Step into the identity of the founder who can hold the vision.
description: The inner work of leading from a vision: identity upgrades, holding the vision when circumstances say otherwise, working through impostor syndrome, and daily practices like Vision Amplifier that keep you connected to where you are going.
coreFocus: Step into the Vision-Driven Entrepreneur identity.
subtopics: Hold the vision, not the circumstance

title: Business and Life, Integrated
tagline: Stop trading your life for your business. Build them together.
description: Integrating business, family, and leadership: marriage and family, rest and reflection, travel, and the practice of designing a business that funds the life you want instead of consuming it.
coreFocus: Integration of business, personal life, and leadership.
